meta.name: saas-idea-validator
meta.description: Evaluates a software or startup idea against problem, market, competition, monetization, defensibility, and execution, and returns a verdict rather than encouragement. Use this when an idea needs pressure-testing before anyone builds, when deciding whether something is worth pursuing, when assessing competition or willingness to pay, or when a validated idea needs a first-customers and MVP plan. Default to scrutiny; the useful answer is usually the unwelcome one.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用无情评审验证创业想法,得到可行结论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你有创业想法但希望在投入开发前被严格检验。
copy.tagline_en: Validate your startup idea with rigorous, honest scrutiny.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a raw idea that needs tough validation before any code is written.

howto.what: 把软件或创业想法按问题、市场、竞争、商业化、防御性、执行六方面审查,给出『值得做』等明确结论,不鼓励。
howto.when: 当用户提出软件/创业想法,需要压力测试、判断是否值得做,或评估竞争与支付意愿等场景时触发。

say.text: 帮我评估这个SaaS创业想法,直言不讳。
say.note: 得到按六维度的审查结论。

say.text: 这个点子我该不该继续做?挑最刺耳的说。
我想验证这个想法,先找首批客户,给个MVP方案。

howto.what_en: Evaluates a software or startup idea across six dimensions (problem, market, competition, monetization, defensibility, execution) and returns a clear verdict, defaulting to skepticism.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a user presents an idea needing stress-testing, a go/no-go assessment, or evaluation of competition and willingness to pay.

say_en.text: Evaluate this SaaS idea and don't sugarcoat it.
Should I pursue this? Give me the harshest answer.
I need first customers and an MVP plan for this.
